Package com.bilt.pos.display

Class DisplayPayloadHelper

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.display.DisplayPayloadHelper
public final class DisplayPayloadHelper extends Object
Utility class for serializing DisplayPayload and InputPayload objects to Base64-encoded XML strings suitable for use in OutputXHTML fields.

Example usage: 


 DisplayPayload payload = DisplayPayloadHelper.standby("standby.xslt");
 String base64 = DisplayPayloadHelper.toBase64(payload);
 // Use base64 in OutputContent.outputXHTML

      public static String toXml(InputPayload payload) throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Serializes an InputPayload to an XML string.

      The output uses a single default namespace declaration (xmlns="urn:bilt:input:v1") for backward compatibility with terminals that expect all elements in the input namespace.

      Parameters:
      payload - the input payload to serialize
      Returns:
      the XML string representation
      Throws:
      jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException - if serialization fails

      public static InputPayload inputFromXml(String xml) throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Deserializes an InputPayload from an XML string.

      This method can parse both the normalized XML format (all elements in urn:bilt:input:v1) produced by toXml(InputPayload) and the raw JAXB format with separate namespaces.

      Parameters:
      xml - the XML string to deserialize
      Returns:
      the deserialized input payload
      Throws:
      jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException - if deserialization fails

    • display

      public static InputPayload display(String title)
      Creates a display-only input payload for use with nexo native input commands (DigitString, DecimalString, TextString, GetMenuEntry).

      Selection behavior for GetMenuEntry (single vs multi-select) is controlled by InputData.minLength/maxLength in the nexo request, not the XML payload.

      Parameters:
      title - the title/prompt to display
      Returns:
      a new input payload with display block only

    • display

    • money

      public static MoneyType money(String currency, double value)
      Creates a money amount from a double value.

      The value is formatted with 2 decimal places to preserve cents precision (e.g., 107.00 stays as "107.00", not "107.0").

      Parameters:
      currency - the currency symbol or code (e.g., "$" or "USD")
      value - the monetary value
      Returns:
      a new MoneyType instance
